label: Goal-relative force grants the actual-force concession for aiming subjects (inference)
rule: Goal-relative force introduction at the actual preference
meaning: Conditional analyst argument, attribution deferred: under goal-relative force, an ordinary belief reason of a subject whose actual preference has the aim has force at that preference. Checks that the rival account grants the concession premise of the answerability argument; it does not establish that any subject has such a reason.
